description: Statistical strength of the rotarod negative, molar dose margin versus diazepam, and PAMPA permeability against assay controls
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

print("="*72)
print("A. HOW STRONG IS THE ROTAROD NEGATIVE? (system 8, PMID 37418196 method 4.6, n=12)")
print("="*72)
n = 12
# The readout is 'fell twice before 3 min'. No compound-treated mouse was reported impaired.
# Exact one-sided 95% upper bound on the true impairment rate given 0/12 events (rule of three / Clopper-Pearson).
ub95 = 1 - 0.05**(1/n)
ub99 = 1 - 0.01**(1/n)
print(f"0 of {n} mice impaired -> exact 95% upper bound on impairment incidence = {ub95*100:.1f}%")
print(f"                           exact 99% upper bound                        = {ub99*100:.1f}%")
print("So the assay excludes an impairment incidence above ~22%, not a small or subclinical CNS effect.")

# Continuous-readout power: detectable Cohen's d at n=12/group, two-sided, Bonferroni over 10 compounds
from statsmodels.stats.power import TTestIndPower
pw = TTestIndPower()
for alpha, lab in [(0.05,"uncorrected"), (0.05/10,"Bonferroni over 10 compounds")]:
    d = pw.solve_power(effect_size=None, nobs1=n, alpha=alpha, power=0.8, ratio=1.0)
    print(f"  minimum detectable Cohen's d at n={n}/group, 80% power, alpha={alpha:.4f} ({lab}): d = {d:.2f}")

print("\n" + "="*72)
print("B. DOSE MARGIN OF THE BBB CLAIM: compounds 40 mg/kg p.o. vs diazepam 8 mg/kg")
print("="*72)
mw_5c = 425.02   # C20H13BrFN3O2, from HRMS [M+H]+ calcd 426.02479 (full text 4.2.4)
mw_dzp = 284.74  # diazepam
d_cmpd = 40/mw_5c*1000; d_dzp = 8/mw_dzp*1000
print(f"5c   40 mg/kg / MW {mw_5c} = {d_cmpd:.1f} umol/kg")
print(f"DZP   8 mg/kg / MW {mw_dzp} = {d_dzp:.1f} umol/kg")
print(f"molar margin = {d_cmpd/d_dzp:.2f}x   (mass margin = {40/8:.0f}x)")
print("The paper states diazepam has affinity similar to 5c, so the comparison is near-isoaffinity;")
print("the CNS-silence claim is therefore demonstrated at ~3.3-fold the molar dose of a positive control.")

print("\n" + "="*72)
print("C. PAMPA PERMEABILITY OF 5a-j AGAINST THE ASSAY'S OWN CONTROLS (system 3)")
print("="*72)
ctrl = {"ranitidine (low)":-7.0, "naproxen (medium)":-5.0, "verapamil (high)":-4.0, "4h (best 4-series)":-4.6}
acid_lo, acid_hi = -7.1, -6.4
for k,v in ctrl.items():
    print(f"  {k:24s} logPe={v:5.1f}  Pe={10**v:.2e} cm/s")
print(f"  acids 5a-j               logPe={acid_hi:.1f} to {acid_lo:.1f}  Pe={10**acid_hi:.2e} to {10**acid_lo:.2e} cm/s")
print(f"  5a-j most permeable member is {10**acid_hi/10**ctrl['ranitidine (low)']:.1f}x the low-permeability control ranitidine")
print(f"  5a-j least permeable member is {10**ctrl['ranitidine (low)']/10**acid_lo:.1f}x BELOW ranitidine")
print(f"  gap to the high-permeability control verapamil: {10**ctrl['verapamil (high)']/10**acid_hi:.0f}x to {10**ctrl['verapamil (high)']/10**acid_lo:.0f}x")

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(11,4.2))
ax = axes[0]
labs = list(ctrl.keys())+["acids 5a-j\n(range)"]
vals = list(ctrl.values())+[(acid_lo+acid_hi)/2]
err  = [0,0,0,0,(acid_hi-acid_lo)/2]
cols = ["#C44E52","#DD8452","#55A868","#8172B3","#4C72B0"]
ax.barh(range(len(labs)), vals, xerr=err, color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(labs))); ax.set_yticklabels(labs, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("log $P_e$ (cm/s)"); ax.set_xlim(-7.6,-3.5)
ax.axvline(-7.0, ls="--", c="#888", lw=1)
ax.set_title("PAMPA: the carboxylic acids sit at or below\nthe assay's low-permeability control", fontsize=9.5)

ax = axes[1]
ks = np.arange(0,7)
ax.plot(ks, [1-0.05**(1/12) if k==0 else stats.beta.ppf(0.95, k+1, 12-k) for k in ks], "o-", color="#4C72B0")
ax.axhline(ub95, ls="--", c="#C44E52")
ax.annotate(f"observed 0/12\nupper bound {ub95*100:.0f}%", xy=(0,ub95), xytext=(1.4,0.30),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#C44E52"), color="#C44E52", fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("mice impaired out of 12"); ax.set_ylabel("95% upper bound on impairment rate")
ax.set_title("Rotarod at n=12 bounds CNS impairment incidence\nonly below about 22%", fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
